label: B25-NOFP-VOLATILE-SOF-PACKAGE
title: Generate and freeze one volatile SOF from the accepted no-FP fitted database
scope: Hash-audit the accepted T-004 post-STA project, clone it into a new task-owned directory, invoke Quartus assembler exactly once, and freeze the resulting catapult_a10.sof plus reports. No programmer, terminal or board access occurs in this task.

validation.preflight: No EDA/programmer/terminal process; T-004 fit/STA reports and source identities match accepted hashes; source contains no configuration artifact; sufficient disk headroom.
validation.clone: Source and clone pre-assembler manifests are identical and source remains immutable.
validation.assembler: Quartus Prime Assembler Successful, 0 errors; exactly one catapult_a10.sof; assembler report identifies final root_partition/auto_fab_0 snapshots.
validation.postflight: No POF/JIC/RBF/JBC/SVF/JAM; only assembler report/index/runlog allowlist may change in the clone database; final/partitioned/synthesized fitted payload is unchanged.

acceptance: One content-addressed volatile SOF is produced from an isolated clone of the exact accepted T-004 physical project, with source immutability and fitted-database payload closure proven. Any identity or unexpected database/config-format change fails closed.
resource: Every GamePC operation acquires gamepc; one foreground assembler invocation; no local heavy work.
authorization: The user explicitly authorized Quartus/JTAG programming and device tests. This task uses only the assembler subset and makes no board state change.
next_after_acceptance: T-20260919-007 may configure this exact SOF into volatile FPGA SRAM and run the resident-monitor console protocol.
